NSF-2026-881.name: NSF DeepTech Phase I
rules: Clause 9.1: Zero foreign contractor spend without 30-day prior written agency approval.
Clause 4.2: Cumulative travel expenses capped at $8,000 total across all team members.

EU-HORIZON-409.name: Horizon Europe EIC Transition
rules: Article 12: Subcontracting capped at 15% of total budget.
Article 6: Equipment deprecation must span 36 months minimum.

memories.content: Sarah Miller booked transatlantic flights and lodging for 2 devs attending NeurIPS Munich ($5,400 of $8,000 travel cap).
